name: lightcone-research
description: Agent skills for Lightcone Research — ASTRA authoring and validation.
generated: Run `npm run build` to regenerate. Do not edit by hand.

skills.name: astra
skills.description: ASTRA (astra.yaml) support: what the format is, and how to drive the `astra` CLI. Invoke whenever reading, writing, validating, or restructuring an astra.yaml spec, working with universes, declared analyses, evidence or how results stand against their records, upgrading a spec written before ASTRA 0.1, or when the user asks about ASTRA.

skills.name: feedback
skills.description: File feedback on the Lightcone Research stack as a GitHub issue in the LightconeResearch/feedback repository, with evidence gathered and sanitized from the session. Use when the user asks to report a bug, file or open an issue, send feedback, or suggest a feature for a tool in the Lightcone Research stack. Not for bugs in the user's own analysis code, and never file anything without the user's approval.

skills.name: lightcone
skills.description: Companion for a Lightcone project — an ASTRA analysis (astra.yaml) executed with the `lc` CLI. Use this skill whenever the user wants to scope, resume, plan, run, debug, share, publish or discuss such a project: "new analysis", "scope a project", "resume the project", "where were we", "run the pipeline", "lc status/materialize/run/fetch/publish", "lc compute", "launch a cluster", "run on GPUs", "put it on GitHub", "clone the analysis", "upgrade the project". Also use it whenever the working directory holds an astra.yaml and the user asks to run, re-run, fix or interpret an analysis, even if they never say "Lightcone", "ASTRA" or "lc". Do NOT use it for the astra.yaml format itself — schema, decisions, universes, evidence and quotes are the astra skill's.

plugins.name: astra
plugins.description: Reference for ASTRA 0.1 (astra.yaml) and its `astra` CLI: inputs tracked in git, outputs and their recipes, decisions and options, universes written in astra.yaml, declared analyses read by address, prior insights and findings with evidence and quote verification, how results stand against their records, and upgrading a 0.0.x spec. Invoke when reading, writing, validating, or debugging an astra.yaml spec, or when the user asks about ASTRA. Ships hooks that validate astra.yaml on save and orient agents at session start in an ASTRA project.

plugins.name: lightcone
plugins.description: Companion for working on a Lightcone project — an ASTRA 0.1 analysis (astra.yaml) executed with the `lc` CLI. Covers the project model (a uv project, direct or containerized, stored as a DataLad dataset), the development workflow (allocate a cluster with `lc compute`, probe with `lc run`, integrate recipes, commit, `lc materialize`), recipe resources and GPUs, status interpretation (ok/behind/stale/missing, unfetched) and failure diagnosis, sharing the project with `lc publish` and reading a clone's data with `lc fetch`, and how to engage the user at each phase: interview to scope a brand-new project, orient and summarize when resuming an existing one. Invoke whenever the user wants to start, resume, plan, run, debug, or discuss a Lightcone/ASTRA analysis project. Bundles the `astra` plugin (spec reference, validate-on-save & session-start hooks) — install `lightcone` alone to get the full stack.
